rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Resolution of Appreciation adopted at the 85th Plenary Session on 25 February 2023 calls her 'former President Smt Sonia Gandhi' (पूर्व कांग्रेस अध्यक्षा in the Hindi), 'the longest-serving President in the history of the Indian National Congress', and says 'One of her very last acts as Congress President was to announce the launch of the historic and transformational Bharat Jodo Yatra'.
